info.title: TalentMesh API
info.description:
Generated from app/api/ by scripts/generate-openapi.ts — do not edit by hand, run `npm run docs:openapi`.

Auth is a session cookie (`tm_access_token`), not a bearer header. Roles and permissions shown as `x-allowed-roles` / `x-required-permission` are read from the withApi() options that actually enforce them.

Operations flagged `x-undocumented-body` do not use withApi(), so their request shape is not declared anywhere machine-readable and has been left blank rather than guessed.
